realistictrees.configuration.title: Realistic Trees settings
realistictrees.configuration.windStrengt: 0 = trees stand still, 1 = default, 5 = extreme tilt.
realistictrees.configuration.gustiness.t: How much the tilt varies in gusts.
realistictrees.configuration.useExternal: Use the wind provided by RealWeather when available.
realistictrees.configuration.animationDi: Trees farther than this do not sway. Lower = more FPS.
realistictrees.configuration.renderDista: Trees farther than this are not drawn.
realistictrees.configuration.replaceWorl: Replace all natural trees (every wood type) when chunks load.
realistictrees.configuration.replaceSapl: Trees grown from saplings or bone meal also become realistic.
If off, trees can be chopped by hand.
realistictrees.configuration.treeScale.t: Size multiplier for all replaced trees.
realistictrees.configuration.minLeaves.t: Log clusters with fewer natural leaves count as player builds and are not replaced.
realistictrees.configuration.chunksPerTi: Chunks scanned for trees per server tick. Lower = less lag.
